svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 17 — "The Sighting" — FULL PAGE — the Titan on the far bank, the grin is gone
svg.desc: Page 17: 1 full-page panel. THE KEY MOMENT. Jink hovers at the lighthouse gallery in the foreground, wings fully deployed in emerald geometric lattice but body rigid, the grin gone. Across the dark river on the far bank, between warehouses, a SHAPE — taller than the buildings, still where the fog moves, edges shimmering with dark iridescence (oil on water, bruise-purple and black). Where the lighthouse beam crosses the far bank it illuminates fog and brick — but the shape ABSORBS the light. A void in the amber. Predatory wrongness. JINK (comms, trembling): "Sable." JINK: "There's something on the far bank."
